findings.title: Secure assertion computed from pre-edit state and weakly checked
findings.message: For secure kind, the final check compares secureValue() with expectedSecure, but calls is asserted to be 1 only in the else-if branch. The test never verifies that the secure edit actually fires exactly once, since calls is only checked inside the non-color else-if (which does run for secure). However, expectedSecure is computed before Return from the pre-edit text, which may be flaky if selection offsets are UTF-16 in the editing state, and the test would pass vacuously if secureValue is nil for other kinds.
findings.suggestion: Assert the secure state explicitly within the secure case after Return, and guard the selection computation against an empty or unexpected EditingState.
